university.name: Kingston University
university.summary: Kingston University is a public university in Kingston upon Thames. It teaches undergraduate and taught postgraduate courses to international students, accepts direct applications from them, publishes country-specific entry guidance including for Pakistan, and offers several international tuition reductions.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of licensed sponsors: students, listed as Student Sponsor - Track Record, register dated 2026-10-07)

courses.title: Data Science MSc
courses.duration_text: Full-time duration not stated on the course page; optional professional placement of 10 to 12 months can be added
courses.overview: A taught master's in data engineering, analytics and machine learning, assessed through four 30-credit modules and a 60-credit project, with an optional placement year. The course page states BCS accreditation. Part-time study is also offered.
courses.academic_requirements: The course page does not list entry criteria. Kingston's Pakistan guidance for postgraduate (Level 7) entry: four-year bachelor's degree with an overall GPA of 2.5 or 50 per cent, or a master's degree after a two or three year bachelor's with the same minimum.
courses.english_requirements: Postgraduate, other faculties: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with at least 59 in each element. TOEFL iBT from January 2026 is listed on a new scale: overall 4.5, with two elements at 4.5 and two at 4. The page lists Duolingo as not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Postgraduate entry: four-year bachelor's with GPA 2.5 or 50 per cent minimum; the GPA scale is not stated on the page. Medium of instruction letters are accepted from approved Pakistani institutions as proof of English (not for franchise or affiliated provision).
courses.career_notes: Page cites roles such as data engineer, data analyst and machine learning engineer.
courses.application_deadline_note: No start month for 2027 is stated on the course page; applications close when the course is full.
courses.notes: Fee is the full-time overseas fee. Course page shows no UK degree class, duration in months or intake month.

courses.title: Business Analytics MSc
courses.duration_text: One year full-time, with an optional 12-month professional placement afterwards
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's at Kingston Business School applying analytics to business decisions, with modules in visualisation, prediction and prescriptive methods, a dissertation and an optional placement.
courses.academic_requirements: The course page does not list entry criteria. Kingston's Pakistan guidance for postgraduate (Level 7) entry: four-year bachelor's degree with an overall GPA of 2.5 or 50 per cent, or a master's degree after a two or three year bachelor's with the same minimum.
courses.english_requirements: Postgraduate, other faculties: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with at least 59 in each element. TOEFL iBT from January 2026 is listed on a new scale: overall 4.5, with two elements at 4.5 and two at 4. The page lists Duolingo as not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Postgraduate entry: four-year bachelor's with GPA 2.5 or 50 per cent minimum; the GPA scale is not stated on the page. Medium of instruction letters are accepted from approved Pakistani institutions as proof of English (not for franchise or affiliated provision).
courses.career_notes: Page cites roles such as business analyst, business intelligence analyst and management consultant.
courses.application_deadline_note: No start month for 2027 is stated on the course page; applications close when the course is full. An interview or portfolio may be requested.
courses.notes: Course page shows no UK degree class or intake month. Whether the course is eligible for the International Success Support Scholarship for September 2027 depends on faculty listing, not confirmed.

courses.title: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
courses.duration_text: Three years, or four years with an optional professional placement year
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate degree in computing with an optional placement year, delivered mainly in person. The course page states BCS accreditation and lists specialist pathways. International applicants can apply directly rather than through UCAS.
courses.academic_requirements: The course page does not list entry criteria. Kingston's Pakistan guidance for undergraduate entry: Higher Secondary School Certificate with a minimum overall score of 65 per cent; those with only the Secondary School Certificate must first complete an International Foundation Year or the Higher Secondary School Certificate.
courses.english_requirements: Undergraduate: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 59 overall with at least 59 in each element. TOEFL iBT from January 2026 is listed on a new scale: overall 4, with two elements at 4.5 and two at 4. The page lists Duolingo as not accepted. Kingston's Pakistan page states the Higher Secondary School Certificate is not accepted as proof of CEFR B2 English.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Undergraduate entry: Higher Secondary School Certificate with minimum overall 65 per cent. Holders of two or three year bachelor's degrees may be considered case by case for advanced entry.
courses.career_notes: Page cites roles such as systems analyst, software engineer, programmer and network specialist.
courses.application_deadline_note: No start month for 2027 is stated on the course page.
courses.notes: Fee is the Year 1 overseas fee on the course page. The course page shows no entry tariff or intake month.

scholarships.name: International Merit-Based Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 reduction in first-year tuition fees
scholarships.summary: A first-year tuition reduction for international applicants holding an offer for an undergraduate or taught postgraduate course. Selection is based on a personal statement and a short video, not on a first come, first served basis.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for a January or September intake; not already enrolled on a Kingston degree or foundation course. Requires offer email, 300-word personal statement and 1-minute video.
scholarships.deadline_note: Page says applications are closed for the September intake and that the form usually opens in March and October. Whether September 2027 is covered is not stated.

scholarships.name: International Success Support Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,500 tuition reduction; first year for postgraduate, up to three years for undergraduate on eligible courses
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition reduction for overseas-fee students on eligible courses. For September 2027 it covers courses in three named faculties or schools, excluding the MBA. A page FAQ describes it as 2026 entry only, so terms need confirming.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer on an eligible course and assessed as an overseas student for fee purposes. Applied automatically to the fee invoice.
scholarships.notes: Page conflicts: main text lists 2027 intakes, an FAQ says 2026 entry only.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate Progression Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: 15 per cent tuition discount for one year
scholarships.summary: A tuition discount for international students who completed a Kingston undergraduate course with no gap in study and progress to postgraduate study. Applied automatically.
scholarships.criteria_text: Completed a Kingston undergraduate course with no gap in study.
scholarships.notes: Detail taken from the scholarships overview page; the dedicated page was not opened.

scholarships.name: Family Bursary
scholarships.value_text: 10 per cent tuition discount for each family member, every year of study
scholarships.summary: A tuition discount for international fee-paying students with a sibling, parent, child or spouse who is studying or has studied at Kingston. Apply through My Kingston after full enrolment.
scholarships.criteria_text: Direct family connection to a current or previous Kingston student; both members fully enrolled at the same time; evidence of the link required. Cannot be combined with other alumni or loyalty discounts.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications open in September after enrolment is complete.

could_not_verify: Entry requirements, degree class and intake month are not shown on the three course pages as retrieved; academic requirements use Kingston's Pakistan country guidance and are generic to level.
Data Science MSc full-time duration not stated; no September 2027 start stated for any course.
Region not stated on any page opened.
TOEFL iBT is shown on a changed scale from January 2026, so no numeric TOEFL minimum recorded.

Kingston MBA Scholarship (GBP 3,000 or GBP 5,000 from September 2026) and Niloufar Ebrahim Scholarship (up to GBP 1,000) were listed on the overview page but 2027 terms were not opened, so they are excluded.
conflicting_sources: International Success Support Scholarship: main text lists September 2027 courses, FAQ says 2026 entry only on selected courses.
Data Science MSc page gives two different start descriptions for the Success Support Scholarship (September 2026 only vs January or September 2026).
excluded_and_why: Kingston Impact Scholarship: September 2026 MBA only.
Study Abroad, Summer School and Exchange Bursary: for returning visiting students, not new applicants.
Alumni Discount: same eligibility as the Postgraduate Progression Scholarship on the overview page, so not listed separately.
Chevening, Commonwealth, GREAT, Marshall, Fulbright: external bodies or other nationalities.
client_should_confirm: The Pakistan country page and the international admissions timeline showed no notice that recruitment from Pakistan is paused. The admissions timeline names Pakistan among countries encouraged to complete a Pre-CAS interview early.
Part of the Pakistan country page was not read because of page length, so confirm no later notice exists.
September 2027 intake dates and the 2027 window for the International Merit-Based Scholarship are not yet published on the pages opened.
